answer: Signal-vault time lock: a new identity’s pay goes into a public vault that opens only after it emits a verified work signal in every epoch of a waiting period — each signal carries a fable, a signed record of what the job did and who used it, so copied work is exposed. The wait is tied to the funding wallet: the nth identity from one wallet waits n² epochs (1st 1, 10th 100), plus 2 POA vault upkeep per waiting epoch. Time cannot be parallelised, so ten fakes wait 385 epochs and pay 770 POA upkeep while earning nothing; one honest agent waits a single epoch.
